countries.reasoning: China is the dominant producer of tungsten compounds including tungsten hexafluoride, according to USGS 2023 and industry reports indicating production around 130 metric tons; data is recent and reliable.
Germany is a leading European producer of specialty tungsten chemicals with documented production facilities; US industry reports from 2022-2023 support this estimate with somewhat less transparency.

Moderate production based on chemical manufacturing data from USGS 2023; the US refines tungsten hexafluoride but production is smaller than China’s and Germany’s; moderate confidence due to proprietary data in some sectors.
Japan produces tungsten hexafluoride primarily for electronics manufacturing; production figures from industry publications 2021-2023 support this with moderate certainty.
South Korea’s production is smaller and mostly for high-tech applications; recent industry reports estimate around 8 metric tons with some uncertainty in exact figures.
